input.prompt: Trail 155 follow-up (https://entire.com/gh/orin-dx/-/trails/155): four OPEN Entire agent-review findings sit on already-merged product code (change caliper/65, trail 127's shape-detection PR #270). Read them: `entire trail finding list caliper/65 --project gh/orin-dx --freshness any --status any --include-dismissed --json` (sandbox off), file paths and lines are in location.filePath/startLine. They are: (1) crates/core/src/extractor/wrapper.rs:355 with `GroupProps extends HTMLChakraProps<"div">`, private `StyledGroup = chakra("div", {})` then `Group = withContext<HTMLDivElement, GroupProps>(StyledGroup)`: the source-order promotion loop (wrapper.rs ~245-275, visit.rs ~308-309) checks StyledGroup before Group has a mapping, so the public component's props go to the private factory and an extra entry is emitted; (2) wrapper.rs:344 `type ButtonProps = Omit<ComponentProps<"button">, "color">` classifies as CollectedTypeAlias::Omit (extractor/alias.rs ~38) which the tag-evidence match rejects, so `export const Button = styled("button", {})` disappears (Partial, Required, Pick and union aliases likewise); (3) component.rs:193 `import { forwardRef } from './utils'` with a generic call and unannotated render parameters now reaches generic-wrapper promotion (visit.rs ~294-309) which assigns WrapperTypeArgument (wrapper.rs ~167), so resolver/mod.rs ~934 stops adding the previously emitted `ref`; (4) component.rs:282 `memo(forwardRef<HTMLDivElement>())` reaches a branch that indexes a one-element type-argument list and PANICS, and the containment fallback (pipeline/revision.rs ~267-275) then discards EVERY component in that file. For EACH: first try to REFUTE it (write the exact source from the finding as a fixture and run `extract`; if it does not reproduce on current origin/main, say so with the output and do not change code). For each that reproduces: write the failing exact-content test first (crates/core/tests, in the style of the existing detection tests), then fix at the root (check type-argument counts before indexing; look inside Omit/Partial/Required/Pick/union alias variants for the tag evidence; preserve the foreign-forwardRef ref rule when promoting generic calls; promote generic candidates before tagged-factory selection or reserve their props), run the precision sample if a detection rule's reach changes (scripts/precision-sample.py), and `just bench`-level sanity on one corpus if the extractor hot path changes. THEN the pattern hunt the user asked for: the panic is an unchecked-indexing class (`indexing_slicing` has 53 hits in core non-test code per the earlier review): grep crates/core/src/extractor and resolver for indexing a Vec/slice/args list by a constant or by an unchecked position (`[0]`, `[1]`, `.params[..]`, `type_args[..]`, `arguments[..]`) after only a partial check, and for each hit decide: provably safe (say why in one line) or a latent panic (write a test that triggers it with source text and fix). Report a table-free list of every hit with the verdict. Also enable nothing project-wide (a later trail ratchets the lint). Branches: one branch per reproduced finding is overkill: use `fix/shape-detection-review-findings` (one commit per finding) off current origin/main (fetch first); skip a finding's commit if it does not reproduce. Full CI set: `CI=1 CALIPER_TEST_TSC=<worktree>/apps/oracle/node_modules/typescript-beta/bin/tsc cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `just lint doc-check typos machete`, `just semver`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` first. Changeset (patch, outcome first: a file no longer loses all its components when ..., etc.). GPG-signed commits (/usr/bin/git, one plain command per call, sandbox off for git writes, verify %G?=G), never push, never open PRs, never merge. Commit trailer `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_013R2ytvK9B32ZaSUaSe6aAZ`. Before reporting, self-review the diff for unused parameters, comments that describe the code as it is, silently dropped inputs. Final report: tip SHA, per-finding verdict (reproduced/refuted with evidence), the indexing audit list, test evidence (failing then passing), draft PR body (succinct, trail URL, session URL last).
